currentTask.title: M2 first ticket: local table setup for two through twelve players with stable identities

requirements.text: Application first renders an accessible new-table form defaulting to four players. Starting any whole count from two through twelve creates exactly that many players, named and seated in order, each at 40 life and zero poison.

Reject empty input, fractions, non-finite values, unsafe integers, counts below two and above twelve before allocation. Show a visible accessible inline error and retain the input for correction. Two-through-twelve is this ticket scope, not a permanent product ceiling.

Assign each player a distinct stable ID and seat on table creation. Use IDs for React keys and targeted updates, not names or array positions. Keep IDs, seat order and values stable through rerenders, inspector open/close and viewport changes.

Keep decrement left and increment right. Each activation changes only the intended player value by one. Preserve negative life, poison floor at zero, modal focus behavior, and all queued updates; twelve-player overflow must scroll without shrinking targets.

Use shared typed custom React components and Storybook stories for the setup form and representative two-, four- and twelve-player tables. Maintain visible focus, accessible input and control names, minimum 48px targets, narrow layouts and readable enlarged text.

Preserve existing behavioral assertions, adding model, rendered setup and browser regression coverage for valid/invalid counts, unique/stable identities, Player 12 isolation and resize preservation. Keep layout mode selection and paging for the next ticket.

nonGoals: No counts above twelve, in-session player addition/removal/renaming, reset/replacement of an active game, configurable layouts, paging, portrait roster/selected editor, or Tabletop rotation.
No persistence, generic trackers, commander damage, undo, gestures, networking, dependency additions or audit-policy changes.
